hook_text: POV: my phone joined the fridge art

song.title: On The Fridge
song.style: English, 1960s-style soul with horn section, organ, tambourine, warm male lead vocal with backing harmonies, 104 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hung my phone up with the art
Right beside the kid's giraffe
Grocery list and birthday card
Now it's part of every laugh

[Chorus]
On the fridge, on the fridge
That's where the good stuff lives
On the fridge, on the fridge
Come and dance in the kitchen

shots.prompt: A little kid proudly sticks a crayon drawing of a sun onto a fridge door with a magnet, then jumps with excitement. Static medium shot. Bright kitchen morning light, sunny yellow.
A couple dances in a small kitchen, spinning each other around while a pot bubbles on the stove. The camera circles slowly. Warm golden light.
A grandpa flips open a cookbook, squints at it, then grins and pulls on an apron. Static close-up. Warm window light.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm kitchen light drifts across the fridge. Static close-up, the camera eases back slightly as the hand pulls away.
A family sits around a wooden kitchen table sharing a big bowl of noodles, everyone laughing. Overhead shot, slowly rotating. Warm lamp light, orange and cream.
A girl plays a ukulele on the kitchen counter while her cat bats at the strings. Static medium shot. Soft afternoon light.
A man opens the fridge, pulls out a slice of watermelon and takes a huge bite. Close-up. Cool fridge light mixing with warm kitchen sun.
Friends bake cookies together, one sneaking a bite of dough as another laughs. Static medium shot. Warm golden light.
A woman sits on the back steps of the kitchen with a cup of tea, watching fireflies over the garden at dusk. The camera slowly pulls back. Deep blue and warm amber.

endcard.line1: Phone on fridge. Feet on floor.

caption: My phone lives on the fridge now, in its Hibernator, next to the good drawings. Kitchen dance parties are back.
